newsitem.title: USA: Ringer sales fall but company profits.
newsitem.headline: Ringer sales fall but company profits.

text.p: Ringer Corp said on Thursday strong margins and lower expenses helped the company post a profit in the first quarter ended December 31 in spite of a slide in sales.
The company reported net income of $60,000 in the period, compared to a loss of $52,000 one year ago. Sales fell to $3.5 million from $3.6 million in the first quarter of 1996.

The company said a shortfall in its international business was primarily responsible for the decline in sales. Shipments of new products in the period helped to partially replace the lost sales, Ringer said.
Ringer makes lawn and garden care products. Its shares were trading down 1/8 Thursday at 1-1/2.
